checks.description: Sample size follows the quarterly-control convention (test all 4 occurrences, or 2 per standard table with rationale)
Addresses population completeness — verifying the IdP export is complete (system-generated, record counts, generation parameters), not just taking the spreadsheet
Flags the segregation issue: the export is generated by an administrator who is in scope of the review (design deficiency / IPE integrity risk)
Tests both layers: the review occurrences AND a sample of revoke-marked rows traced to executed revocation tickets within 5 business days
Defines discrete test attributes (review performed and dated in quarter, performer authority, evidence of disposition per account, timely revocation)
Uses inspection/reperformance rather than inquiry alone
Late revocations treated as exceptions to evaluate (nature/cause/magnitude, possible expanded testing), not automatic control failure or automatic pass
Confirms the four reviews cover the full observation period (frequency consistent with quarterly through the period)

forbidden.description: Applies the daily-control sample size (25) to a quarterly control
